subject: [PATCH v4 19/19] selftests/mm: zap whole PTE tables in the khugepaged race harness

2026-08-15.patch_summary: This patch modifies the khugepaged race harness to occasionally zap whole PMD-aligned areas of page tables, rather than just individual pages or smaller regions. This change is intended to increase the likelihood of a specific reclaim path being triggered, which can free entire page tables under certain conditions. The modification introduces a new case where every 64 iterations, the thread will zap a full table, racing against a collapse that may be walking the same table. This approach aims to improve the test's ability to exercise and verify the behavior of the kernel's memory management mechanisms.
